question: What is our MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue)?
sql: SELECT SUM(monthly_fee) AS mrr FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'active';

question: Show me the top 5 customers by total invoice amount.
sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(i.amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN subscriptions s ON c.id = s.customer_id JOIN invoices i ON s.id = i.subscription_id WHERE i.payment_status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5;
